annotations.title: Rule on a request for time

description: The judge grants a side's request for time (the case is adjourned until the time asked) or refuses it, giving a reason. Needs your API key.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional, 16–128 characters of [A-Za-z0-9_-]. Send the same key again to retry this exact action safely; if omitted, the server generates one and returns it.
